generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client"
  output   = "../src/generated/prisma"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
}

model User {
  id                  String                  @id
  name                String
  email               String                  @unique
  emailVerified       Boolean                 @default(false)
  image               String?
  createdAt           DateTime                @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime                @updatedAt
  username            String?                 @unique
  displayUsername     String?
  accounts            Account[]
  accountDeletion     accountDeletionRequest?
  analyses            analysis[]
  billingSubscription billingSubscription[]
  comparisons         comparison[]
  scans               scan[]
  scanUsage           scanUsage[]
  sessions            Session[]
  preference          userPreference?

  @@map("user")
}

model userPreference {
  userId        String   @id
  pregnancyMode Boolean  @default(false)
  riskAlerts    Boolean  @default(true)
  locale        String   @default("es-ES")
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt
  user          User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

model scanUsage {
  id          String   @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  userId      String
  periodStart DateTime @db.Date
  consumed    Int      @default(0)
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, periodStart])
}

model scan {
  id               String     @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  userId           String
  status           scanStatus @default(UPLOADED)
  imageMimeType    String
  imageSize        Int
  productName      String?
  ingredientsText  String?
  ocrConfidence    Float?
  failureCode      String?
  failureMessage   String?
  failureRetryable Boolean?
  createdAt        DateTime   @default(now())
  updatedAt        DateTime   @updatedAt
  analysis         analysis?
  user             User       @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
}

model analysis {
  id                      String                @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  userId                  String
  scanId                  String                @unique @db.Uuid
  productName             String
  ingredientsText         String
  overallRisk             productRiskLevel
  pregnancyRisk           analysisPregnancyRisk
  summary                 String
  detectedAdditives       Json
  unrecognizedIngredients Json
  pregnancyModeApplied    Boolean               @default(false)
  saved                   Boolean               @default(false)
  createdAt               DateTime              @default(now())
  updatedAt               DateTime              @updatedAt
  scan                    scan                  @relation(fields: [scanId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user                    User                  @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([userId, saved, createdAt])
}

model comparison {
  id                    String   @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  userId                String
  leftAnalysisId        String   @db.Uuid
  rightAnalysisId       String   @db.Uuid
  recommendedAnalysisId String?  @db.Uuid
  reason                String
  createdAt             DateTime @default(now())
  user                  User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
}

model accountDeletionRequest {
  userId      String   @id
  requestedAt DateTime @default(now())
  scheduledAt DateTime
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
}

model Session {
  id        String   @id
  expiresAt DateTime
  token     String   @unique
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
  ipAddress String?
  userAgent String?
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("session")
}

model Account {
  id                    String    @id
  accountId             String
  providerId            String
  userId                String
  accessToken           String?
  refreshToken          String?
  idToken               String?
  accessTokenExpiresAt  DateTime?
  refreshTokenExpiresAt DateTime?
  scope                 String?
  password              String?
  createdAt             DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime  @updatedAt
  user                  User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("account")
}

model Verification {
  id         String   @id
  identifier String
  value      String
  expiresAt  DateTime
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([identifier])
  @@map("verification")
}

model additive {
  id                   String                 @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  eNumber              String                 @unique(map: "additive_e_number_key")
  name                 String
  description          String
  foodUses             String
  healthImpact         String
  lowDoseEffects       String?
  highDoseEffects      String?
  toxicityLevel        toxicityLevel
  pregnancySuitability pregnancySuitability   @default(UNKNOWN)
  pregnancyRationale   String
  curationStatus       curationStatus         @default(REVIEW_REQUIRED)
  contentUpdatedAt     DateTime               @default(now())
  createdAt            DateTime               @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime
  additiveAlias        additiveAlias[]
  additiveSourceRecord additiveSourceRecord[]

  @@index([pregnancySuitability], map: "additive_pregnancy_suitability_idx")
  @@index([toxicityLevel], map: "additive_toxicity_level_idx")
}

model additiveAlias {
  id             String   @id(map: "additive_alias_pkey") @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  additiveId     String   @db.Uuid
  name           String
  normalizedName String
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  additive       additive @relation(fields: [additiveId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade, map: "additive_alias_additive_id_fkey")

  @@unique([additiveId, normalizedName], map: "additive_alias_additive_id_normalized_name_key")
  @@index([normalizedName], map: "additive_alias_normalized_name_idx")
}

model additiveIngestionRun {
  id                String            @id(map: "additive_ingestion_run_pkey") @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  sourceId          String            @db.Uuid
  status            ingestionStatus   @default(RUNNING)
  discovered        Int               @default(0)
  imported          Int               @default(0)
  failed            Int               @default(0)
  errorSummary      String?
  startedAt         DateTime          @default(now())
  completedAt       DateTime?
  informationSource informationSource @relation(fields: [sourceId], references: [id], map: "additive_ingestion_run_source_id_fkey")

  @@index([sourceId, startedAt], map: "additive_ingestion_run_source_id_started_at_idx")
}

model additiveSourceRecord {
  id                   String               @id(map: "additive_source_record_pkey") @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  additiveId           String               @db.Uuid
  sourceId             String               @db.Uuid
  sourceUrl            String
  sourceName           String
  description          String
  foodUses             String
  healthImpact         String
  lowDoseEffects       String?
  highDoseEffects      String?
  toxicityLevel        toxicityLevel
  sourceClassification String?
  pregnancySuitability pregnancySuitability @default(UNKNOWN)
  pregnancyRationale   String
  contentHash          String
  fetchedAt            DateTime
  lastSeenAt           DateTime
  createdAt            DateTime             @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime
  additive             additive             @relation(fields: [additiveId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade, map: "additive_source_record_additive_id_fkey")
  informationSource    informationSource    @relation(fields: [sourceId], references: [id], map: "additive_source_record_source_id_fkey")

  @@unique([additiveId, sourceId], map: "additive_source_record_additive_id_source_id_key")
  @@index([sourceId, lastSeenAt], map: "additive_source_record_source_id_last_seen_at_idx")
}

model billingPlan {
  id                  String                    @id(map: "billing_plan_pkey")
  name                String
  billingPeriod       billingPeriod
  trialDays           Int                       @default(0)
  capabilities        String[]
  monthlyScanLimit    Int?
  amountMinor         Int?
  currency            String?                   @db.Char(3)
  isPublic            Boolean                   @default(false)
  isPurchasable       Boolean                   @default(false)
  createdAt           DateTime                  @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime
  productReferences   billingProductReference[]
  billingSubscription billingSubscription[]

  @@index([isPublic], map: "billing_plan_is_public_idx")
}

model billingProductReference {
  id          String             @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  planId      String
  provider    billingProvider
  environment billingEnvironment
  productId   String
  createdAt   DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime           @updatedAt
  billingPlan billingPlan        @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([provider, environment, productId])
  @@unique([planId, provider, environment])
}

model billingWebhookEvent {
  id          String          @id
  provider    billingProvider
  payloadHash String
  receivedAt  DateTime        @default(now())
  processedAt DateTime?

  @@index([provider, receivedAt])
}

model billingSubscription {
  id                 String                    @id(map: "billing_subscription_pkey") @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  userId             String
  planId             String
  provider           billingProvider
  environment        billingEnvironment
  externalPurchaseId String
  status             billingSubscriptionStatus
  currentPeriodStart DateTime?
  currentPeriodEnd   DateTime?
  cancelAtPeriodEnd  Boolean                   @default(false)
  canceledAt         DateTime?
  revokedAt          DateTime?
  createdAt          DateTime                  @default(now())
  updatedAt          DateTime
  billingPlan        billingPlan               @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id], map: "billing_subscription_plan_id_fkey")
  user               User                      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade, map: "billing_subscription_user_id_fkey")

  @@unique([provider, environment, externalPurchaseId], map: "billing_subscription_provider_environment_external_purchase_key")
  @@index([status, currentPeriodEnd], map: "billing_subscription_status_current_period_end_idx")
  @@index([userId, updatedAt], map: "billing_subscription_user_id_updated_at_idx")
}

model informationSource {
  id                   String                 @id(map: "information_source_pkey") @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  key                  String                 @unique(map: "information_source_key_key")
  name                 String
  baseUrl              String
  createdAt            DateTime               @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime
  additiveIngestionRun additiveIngestionRun[]
  additiveSourceRecord additiveSourceRecord[]
}

model informationScore {
  id        String   @id(map: "informationScorePkey") @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  key       String   @unique(map: "informationScoreKeyKey")
  name      String
  baseUrl   String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime
}

File: src/common/auth/auth.instance.ts
================
import { betterAuth } from 'better-auth';
import { prismaAdapter } from 'better-auth/adapters/prisma';
import { PrismaClient } from '../../generated/prisma/client';
import { Resend } from 'resend';
import { expo } from '@better-auth/expo';
import { dash, sentinel } from '@better-auth/infra';
import { magicLink, username } from 'better-auth/plugins';

export const createAuth = (prisma: PrismaClient) =>
  betterAuth({
    plugins: [
      expo(),
      sentinel(),
      username(),
      magicLink({
        sendMagicLink: async ({ email, url }) => {
          const resend = new Resend(process.env.RESEND_API_KEY);
          await resend.emails.send({
            from: 'no-reply@ingredia.fit',
            to: email,
            template: {
              id: 'ingredia-sign-in',
              variables: { MAGIC_LINK: url }
            }
          });
        },
      }),
      dash({ apiKey: process.env.BETTER_AUTH_API_KEY }),
    ],

    database: prismaAdapter(prisma, { provider: 'postgresql' }),
    appName: process.env.APP_NAME ?? 'Your app name',
    secret: process.env.BETTER_AUTH_SECRET ?? 'secret',
    baseURL: process.env.BETTER_AUTH_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3000',
    emailAndPassword: {
      enabled: false,
    },
    socialProviders: {
      apple: { clientId: process.env.APPLE_CLIENT_ID as string },
      google: {
        prompt: 'select_account',
        clientId: process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID as string,
        clientSecret: process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET as string,
      },
    },
    session: {
      expiresIn: 60 * 60 * 24 * 7,
      //   Auto Rotation if user is active
      updateAge: 60 * 40 * 24,
      //   Anti violation session
      freshAge: 60 * 60 * 2,
    },
    rateLimit: {
      enabled: true,
      window: 60,
      max: 100,
    },
    trustedOrigins: [
      'ingredia://',
      'ingredia-prod://',
      'ingredia-staging://',
      'ingredia://*',
      ...(process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development'
        ? [
            'exp://', // Trust any host of the exp:// scheme
            'exp://**', // Trust all Expo URLs (wildcard matching)
            'exp://192.168.*.*:*/**', // Trust 192.168.x.x IP range with any port and path
            'http://localhost:3000',
            'http://localhost:8081',
            'http://localhost:3001',
          ]
        : []),
    ],
  });

================
File: src/app.module.ts
================
import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigModule } from '@nestjs/config';
import { AuthModule } from '@thallesp/nestjs-better-auth';

import { PrismaModule } from './common/prisma/prisma.module';
import { PrismaService } from './common/prisma/prisma.service';
import { createAuth } from './common/auth/auth.instance';
import { HealthModule } from './modules/health/health.module';
import { AdditivesModule } from './modules/additives/additives.module';
import { BillingModule } from './modules/billing/billing.module';
import { PreferencesModule } from './modules/preferences/preferences.module';
import { AnalysesModule } from './modules/analyses/analyses.module';

@Module({
  imports: [
    ConfigModule.forRoot({
      isGlobal: true,
    }),
    PrismaModule,
    HealthModule,
    AdditivesModule,
    BillingModule,
    PreferencesModule,
    AnalysesModule,
    AuthModule.forRootAsync({
      imports: [PrismaModule],
      inject: [PrismaService],
      useFactory: (prisma: PrismaService) => ({
        auth: createAuth(prisma),
      }),
    }),
  ],
})
export class AppModule {}

================
File: src/main.ts
================
import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import { Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { SwaggerModule, DocumentBuilder } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AppModule } from './app.module';
import { json } from 'express';
import { ApiExceptionFilter } from './common/http/api-exception.filter';

async function bootstrap() {
  const app = await NestFactory.create(AppModule, {
    bodyParser: false,
  });

  app.use('/additives', json({ limit: '16kb' }));
  app.use('/billing', json({ limit: '64kb' }));
  app.use(
    '/api/v1',
    json({
      limit: '256kb',
      verify: (request, _response, buffer) => {
        (request as typeof request & { rawBody?: Buffer }).rawBody =
          Buffer.from(buffer);
      },
    }),
  );
  app.useGlobalFilters(new ApiExceptionFilter());
  app.enableShutdownHooks();

  app.enableCors({
    origin: true,
    credentials: true,
  });

  const config = new DocumentBuilder()
    .setTitle('Aditivos App API')
    .setDescription('Ingredient scanning and food-additive catalog API')
    .setVersion('1.0')
    .addTag('additives')
    .addTag('catalog')
    .addTag('billing')
    .build();

  const documentFactory = () => SwaggerModule.createDocument(app, config);
  SwaggerModule.setup('api', app, documentFactory); // /api to get swagger document
  await app.listen(process.env.PORT ?? 3000);
}
void bootstrap()
  .then(() => Logger.log('API is listening.', 'Bootstrap'))
  .catch((error: unknown) => Logger.error(error, 'Bootstrap'));
